Class Player

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
Representation of a Player.
This class works as the representation for a Player, storing all its cards and parameters.
each Player is identified by a unique nickname, and has a selection of moves it can make.

    • setMoves

      public void setMoves(int up, int down)
      Set the Player's Moves.
      This method sets the Moves the Player can do next, depending on the Tile it has chosen.
      Pre: up >= 0 && down >= 0
      Post: this.remainingUpMoves = up && this.remainingDownMoves = down
      Parameters:
      up - Number of Cards the Player can pick from the upper row.
      down - Number of Cards the Player can pick from the lower row.

    • updateStats

      public void updateStats(Parameter stat, int sum)
      Update Player's stats.
      This method updates the Player's stats for a specific parameter.
      It handles correctly various edge cases, like not having enough food (avoiding getting a negative value).
      Pre: stat != null
      Post: this.getParameters().get(stat) = /old(this.getParameters().get(stat)) + sum
      Parameters:
      stat - Parameter to update.
      sum - Value to sum to the old value.

    • updateStats

      public void updateStats(SpecialBuff eventBuff)
      Update Player's stats (specialBuffs specific).
      This method updates the Player's stats for the specialBuffs, adding the right buff due to the right Event.
      Pre: eventBuff != null
      Post: this.getSpecialBuffs().get(eventBuff) != null
      Parameters:
      eventBuff - SpecialBuff to add due to an Event.

    • removeBuff

      public void removeBuff(SpecialBuff specialBuff)
      Remove a SpecialBuff.
      This method removes a specialBuff from the Player's stats.
      Pre: eventBuff != null
      Post: this.getSpecialBuffs().get(eventBuff) == null
      Parameters:
      specialBuff - SpecialBuff to remove.
